details.summary:
A Sunrise Adventure from Bangalore

The Skandagiri Sunrise Trek is one of the most rewarding early-morning trekking experiences near Bangalore, Located near Chikkaballapura, approximately 60–70 km from Bangalore.

Skandagiri Hills rises to around1,450 metres above sea level. The trail combines rocky terrain, forest sections, historic ruins and panoramichilltop views, making it an ideal choice for travellers looking for a short but memorable adventure.
Your journey begins late at night in Bangalore. Travel comfortably to Skandagiri, meet your trek leader andbegin your ascent in the early hours of the morning.

As you climb through the darkness, the excitement builds with every step. The reward comes at the summit,where you can watch the sky slowly change colour as the sun rises over the surrounding hills.

On favorable mornings, mist and clouds may cover the valleys below, creating Skandagiri's famous sea-of-clouds experience.

itinerary.title: Bangalore to Skandagiri
itinerary.description: Your Skandagiri adventure begins late at night.

activities.title: Board Vehicle
activities.description:
Meet your trip coordinator at the designated pickup point and board the vehicle for your journey towards Chikkaballapur.
Sit back, relax and get to know your fellow travellers as you leave Bangalore behind.

activities.title: Early Morning | Arrive at Skandagiri Base
activities.description:
Reach the designated base/parking area and prepare for the trek.
After a short safety briefing from your trek leader, get your headlamp ready and begin the climb.

itinerary.title: Conquer Skandagiri Peak
itinerary.description: Start your ascent towards the Skandagiri summit under the night sky.

activities.title: Early Morning | Begin the Trek
activities.description:
The trail takes you through forested sections and uneven terrain, gradually becoming more rocky as yougain elevation.
Maintain a comfortable pace and stay together with the group.

activities.title: Before Sunrise | Approach the Summit
activities.description:
As you climb higher, the darkness slowly begins to fade.
The surrounding landscape starts appearing in the first light of dawn, building anticipation for the sunrise ahead.

activities.title: Sunrise | Reach the Summit
activities.description:
Reach the summit and settle in for the highlight of your Skandagiri Sunrise Trek.
Watch the morning sky transform as the sun rises over the surrounding hills.
On favourable mornings, you may see clouds and mist spread across the valleys below.
Take photographs, enjoy the views and spend some quiet time soaking in the atmosphere.

activities.title: Morning | Explore Kalavara Durga
activities.description:
After sunrise, explore the historic remains around the summit.
Learn more about the old fortifications and enjoy panoramic views of the surrounding countryside.

activities.title: Begin the Descent
activities.description:
Start your descent with your trek leader.
With daylight now covering the trail, you'll get to experience Skandagiri from an entirely different perspective.

activities.title: Trek Ends
activities.description: Reach the base and take some time to rest and freshen up.

activities.title: Breakfast Stop
activities.description: Stop at a local restaurant or en-route eatery for breakfast

activities.title: Return to Bangalore
activities.description: Board the vehicle and begin your journey back to Bangalore.

activities.title: Bangalore Drop
activities.description: Arrive back in Bangalore and conclude your Skandagiri Hills Trek Experience.

sections.title: Things to carry
sections.body:
Things to Carry for Skandagiri Trek
(Since the trek begins during the early hours, packing the right essentials is important.)

[Must Carry]
• Small trekking backpack
• At least 2 litres of drinking water
• Headlamp or torch
• Trekking shoes with good grip
• Light jacket or windcheater
• Extra pair of socks
• Cap
• Sunglasses
• Sunscreen
• Energy bars or dry fruits
• Personal medication
• Fully charged mobile phone
• Power bank
• Valid government-issued ID

 [During Monsoon]
• Rain jacket or poncho
• Waterproof backpack cover
• Waterproof phone pouch
• Extra clothes and socks

Packing Tip 
Keep your backpack light. Avoid carrying unnecessary items as you'll be walking for several hours over uneven terrain.

sections.title: Trail guidelines
sections.body:
Skandagiri is both a natural and historical destination. Help preserve it for future travelers.
"Trek Responsibly. Respect the Hills."

• Follow your trek leader's instructions at all times.
• Follow Forest Department rules and restrictions.
• Stay with the group throughout the trek.
• Remain on the designated trekking trail.
• Do not litter.
• Carry all waste back with you.
• Avoid single-use plastic.
• Do not smoke or consume alcohol during the trek.
• Do not light fires or campfires.
• Do not disturb wildlife.
• Do not damage plants or historical structures.
• Be careful around steep and rocky sections.
• Avoid standing too close to edges while taking photographs.
• Wear appropriate trekking footwear.
• Stay hydrated throughout the trek.
• Take breaks whenever required.
• Avoid loud music that may disturb wildlife and fellow trekkers.

"Leave Only Footprints. Take Only Memories."

sections.title: A Trek with a Story
sections.body:
Skandagiri isn't only about sunrise views, The hill is also known as Kalavara Durga and is home to the remains of an old hill fort traditionallyassociated with the Palegar era of Karnataka.

As you explore the summit, you'll come across remnants of the historic fortifications and structures thatonce occupied the hill.
The hill is also locally associated with the name Kalavara Betta, while the name Skandagiri is connected with Skanda, another name for Lord Subramanya

This combination of history, nature and adventure gives the Skandagiri Trek a character of its own.
